item.title: GovBrief Today #608
item.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche wants the judges who caught ICE breaking 96 court orders blocked from hearing any of its cases. Today Blanche accused all but one of Minnesota's federal judges of misconduct for talking to the New York Times about Operation Metro Surge. In January, Judge Patrick Schiltz, a George W. Bush appointee, counted the violations across 74 cases and warned that "ICE is not a law unto itself." Blanche says the government deserves a fair and impartial judge, "just like every litigant in court." Most litigants who ignore 96 court orders don't get to pick a new judge. I've emailed 9,324 stories over 608 straight nights, free and without ads. The algorithm can't show them all to you. Add your email address at govbrief.today and I will. item.title: My last night with her
item.description: Foster kitten Bump went from FOR REAL bites to very soft, loving, even sometimes licky bites. I’m taking her back to the humane society tomorrow after work to get her last round of shots, and then I’m leaving her there for them to take her to vet Friday morning to get spayed and put up for adoption. So this is my last night with her. I’m gonna soak up every minute
